opti-1: From space, Florida is green and wild, wrapped in blue.
opti-2: On a quiet Gulf beach, little shorebirds race the waves.
opti-4: Let's rewind. Back up the creek. Into a storm drain.
opti-5: Across a rainy parking lot, miles from the beach, to one hand.
opti-6: Now play it forward. Other hands pick things up.
opti-7: So can one person's choice change a whole ecosystem?
22-01-welcome: Our film starts on a Florida beach. First, look closely at what the waves left behind.
22-01-lesson: Today you're the ecosystem detective. Follow the rain, test the ground, then open the case files.
22-01-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
22-01-assign: Time to show what you found. Sort the harm and the help, then explain how one choice changes a home.
how-22-01-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the beach finds, then tap three things you notice.
how-22-01-compare: Put the sponge under one tray and the plastic lid under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Pour the rain. Then swap and pour again.
how-22-01-wall: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-22-01-det: Pick three case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it shows. Predict harm or help, and watch the place today appear.
how-22-01-partc: Draw one place before and after a human action. Label what changed, and one way to help.
